jobs.title: Principal Technology Portfolio Management Leader
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

McKesson Technology (MT) has Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO) which is a centralized function to 1) enable consistent portfolio management 2) build and mature project and program management capabilities and 3) drive project management rigor and standards to enable value realization from investments.

Principal Technology Portfolio Management Leader will be a key member of the EPMO team. The individual will be responsible for serving as a portfolio lead supporting Cybersecurity service area and a Business Unit. The individual in this role will need to be able to operate within a high level of ambiguity, remain calm under pressure and help establish structure and focus.

Key Responsibilities
:

Drive the intake, prioritization, and sequencing of portfolio initiatives with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment with business strategy and maximize business outcomes.
Monitor and track portfolio health by evaluating execution progress, interdependencies, risks, and capacity constraints, proactively recommending sequencing and highlighting issues to enable successful delivery and value realization.
Drive connectivity and collaboration across delivery teams, Finance, and portfolio leads, influencing decisions that support achievement of business goals.
Enable visibility into capacity constraints and facilitate alignment of priorities and trade-offs, ensuring resources are allocated to the most valuable initiatives.
Establish and lead regular portfolio reviews with stakeholders and executive leadership, providing clear reporting on progress, financials, risks, lessons learned, and business impacts to inform decision-making.
Drive annual budget planning with Finance, review baseline financials and investment budgets for initiatives, and collaborate with service managers to guide resource allocation and strategic decisions.
Champion data-driven analysis and actionable insights, connecting project and technology spend to business value, and recommending trade-offs, course corrections, or project terminations as needed.
Maintain portfolio governance and data integrity, ensure projects adhere to established frameworks, complete necessary lifecycle work, and have approved change requests for budget or schedule deviations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, ensuring their needs and expectations are met through effective communication and delivery of portfolio information.
Partner with Finance and embed benefits realization and value tracking into portfolio management by defining clear success metrics upfront, monitoring benefits during and after implementation, and reporting on KPI improvements, cost savings, and revenue growth.
Promote transparency and alignment by providing stakeholders with visibility into how initiatives support strategic objectives, enabling informed prioritization and optimization of the portfolio’s cost/benefit mix.
Support dynamic portfolio rebalancing, adapting to changes in business, financial, or capacity conditions to protect core operations while enabling innovation.
Partner with Finance for ongoing financial forecasting, trend analysis, and investment mix reviews, ensuring high-value opportunities are funded and low-value projects are deprioritized.
Anchor portfolio decisions in enterprise architecture, preventing proliferation of non-strategic platforms and ensuring alignment with target state architecture.
Champion holistic performance and risk management, presenting portfolio health in business terms and elevating discussions from project status to business impact.

Basic Skills and Experience
:

Degree or equivalent and typically requires 13+ years, with 8+ years of direct work-related experience. Less years required if has relevant Master's or Doctorate qualifications.

Critical Skills and Experience
:

8+ years of program and/or portfolio management experience with 5+ years of experience within a technology focused area (Cyber Security, Digital Transformation, IT Infrastructure, Cloud Modernization, etc.).
Demonstrated experience collaborating regularly with VPs, SVPs, and C-suite executives, supported by a background in consulting.
Exceptional executive presentation, communication, and influence management skills.
Experience managing large portfolios and ensuring strategic alignment and prioritization, as well as overseeing investments and value realization—ideally within the technology sector, though a background in general technology combined with business portfolio management is also suitable.
Experience delivering results by collaborating and influencing business and technology delivery teams in a highly matrixed organization.
Proven stakeholder management skills & building credibility with executive leadership.
Ability to intentionally flex between strategy and detail and adapt style to different levels of the organization.
Experience driving organizational transformation and change management.
Ability to make complex concepts simple and convey it laymen’s terms.
Demonstrated ability to establish collaborative relationships and move with speed while bringing people along.
High degree of emotional maturity and ability to remain calm and focused under pressure.

Additional Knowledge & Skills desired but not required
:

Experience managing technology portfolio for a business unit or shared services function is highly desirable.
Experience working in large matrixed organizations is highly desirable.
Experience working with portfolio tools (Planview, Clarity PPM, etc.) is desirable.
Experience in a highly regulated industry is desirable.
Certification(s) in SAFe Agile, Prince2 / APM, PMP and/or Lean Six Sigma desirable.

Travel
:
Hybrid role and may have to travel within the country up to 10%

Relocation is not budgeted for this role

jobs.title: Director, Finance (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
With a company culture rooted in collaboration, expertise and innovation, we aim to promote progress and inspire our clients, employees, investors and communities to achieve their greatest potential. Our work is the catalyst that helps others achieve their goals. In short, We Enable Possibility℠.

Job Summary

Reporting to the VP Finance, the Director of Finance will be responsible statutory and external reporting, corporate income taxes and financial audits. This role ensures financial information is prepared in accurately and on a timely basis and that appropriate internal controls are in place.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Lead IFRS quarter end reporting process and ensure that Canadian statutory reporting requirements are met. This includes the preparation and filing of the annual and quarterly regulatory financial returns (P&C1, MCT), annual audited IFRS financial statements and auditor’s reports and other financial returns required by the regulators.
Work with the SVP Actuary to ensure that actuarial data inputs for the regulatory financial returns and MCT capital returns are reviewed and reconciled to the general ledger.
Work with external consultants to ensure that IFRS 17 SAS data inputs and outputs for the regulatory financial returns are prepared, reviewed and reconciled within the agreed upon reporting timelines.
Prepare quarterly IFRS financial statement analysis and commentary, including preparation of materials for the quarterly Board of Directors meetings.
Oversee the corporate tax function including the preparation of quarterly Canadian and USGAAP tax provisions, corporate tax remittances and providing external tax consultants with relevant working papers for the annual Canadian corporate tax filings.
Prepare annual financial statements, notes to the financial statements, shells and all necessary disclosures for external auditors.
Manage, coordinate and ensure successful completion of external and internal audits including external financial statement audits, corporate tax external audits, internal audits of the Finance function for SOX and internal audits of the MCT capital return for OSFI. This includes dealing directly with auditors to resolve issues.
Assess and implement changes in Canadian IFRS, corporate taxation, OSFI regulations and other applicable accounting standards and regulations related to the P&C1, MCT, IFRS financial statements and Canadian corporate taxes.
Develop and maintain corporate accounting policies to ensure the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls over external financial reporting and SOX compliance with respect to financial reporting processes. This includes preparation of internal control documents and accounting memos relevant to Canada for USGAAP and IFRS/statutory reporting and updating these documents at least annually and as needed.
Prepare annual capital plan and quarterly reforecasts. Prepare long range plan for the Financial conditions testing.
Oversee the completion of external surveys and data requests related to statutory financial statements.
Provide support to the Chief Risk Officer by preparing the quarterly CRO risk report for the Board of Director meetings and executing on the plan to complete the finance related disclosure requirements for ESG reporting /OSFI Guideline B15 Climate Risk Management.
Provide support to the SVP Actuary by filing actuarial related returns required by the regulators i.e. Appointed Actuary’s report and related schedules, external review reports, Financial Condition Testing, ORSA Key Metrics Report and Earthquake Exposure Data Return.
Initiate process improvements as necessary for IFRS accounting and reporting processes including automating of data workflows to enhance the reporting process.

Required Skills And Experience

Minimum 10 years of financial reporting experience
Experience in P&C Insurance accounting (including IFRS17) is essential
A high degree of technical and analytical expertise, excellent verbal, written and communication skills
Ability to work effectively with senior management and an individual who takes initiative, has a strong team orientation and able to prioritize responsibilities to meet tight deadlines with little to no supervision
High degree of accountability and ownership

Desired Skills and Abilities:

Well organized, innovative with a high level of initiative; strong time management skills with the ability to establish priorities to meet tight deadlines while balancing multiple and constantly changing needs and schedules – flexibility is critical
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Detail oriented, able to manage several complex processes/tasks with a high level of accuracy
Exposure to Workday ERP is an asset

Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Accounting
CPA designation

For individuals assigned or hired to work in the location(s) indicated below, the base salary range is provided. Range is as of the time of posting. Position is incentive eligible.

$130,000 - $140,000/year

Total individual compensation (base salary, short & long-term incentives) offered will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to geographic location, scope & responsibilities of the role, qualifications, talent availability & specialization as well as business needs. The above pay range may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: VP, Finance & Accounting
jobs.description:
Rewind is a service that protects the critical data that powers businesses of all sizes. Our focus is on backing up data that lives in the cloud - in apps like Jira, GitHub, Confluence and Shopify. We are backed by Insight Partners, Inovia, Bessemer and Atlassian Ventures and are proud to be recognized as one of Canada's 50 fastest growing technology companies (2023 Deloitte Fast 50). We invite you to read our startup story to learn where we came from and where we’re going.

Read about our mission, story and values here.

To find out more about our perks, click here.

Some of our Blogs might help you get a better understanding of what we do here. You can find them all here.

Thriving At Rewind

We embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:

Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.
Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.
Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.
Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.
Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.
We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.

About The Role

We’re looking for a senior finance leader to own and evolve Rewind’s full finance function spanning accounting, financial planning, and controller responsibilities. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you’ll bring a strong accounting foundation, step confidently into hands-on operational work when needed, and guide the business with clear, data-driven insight.

This is a hands on builder role. You’ll shape the broader finance strategy, while also performing core Accounting and Controller responsibilities. You should expect to roll up your sleeves and operate as both a leader and an individual contributor, handling everything from Board reporting, to financial modelling, to processing payroll and driving month end close. You’ll partner closely with the executive team, particularly the CEO and CRO to ensure Rewind scales with financial clarity, discipline, and confidence.

What You’ll Do

Financial leadership & strategy

Own company-wide financial planning, forecasting, and performance tracking, including SaaS metrics and operating models
Partner with leadership to guide investment decisions, pricing strategy, and growth planning
Deliver clear, actionable financial insights to executives, board members, and investors
Support strategic finance work including scenario planning and executive-level analysis.

Accounting, close operations & compliance

Oversee and continuously improve the month-end close process, ensuring accurate and timely reporting across P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
Maintain high-quality financial reporting and variance analysis to support decision-making
Step into hands-on accounting work where needed, ensuring no gaps in execution as the team scales
Own all core accounting operations, including AP/AR, payroll, treasury, and general ledger management
Lead audits, tax filings, and compliance across jurisdictions, including SR&ED and international subsidiaries
Manage equity administration (e.g., Carta), ensuring accurate cap table and regulatory compliance

Controls, governance & infrastructure

Strengthen internal controls and financial processes to safeguard company assets and support scale
Oversee vendor relationships, banking, insurance programs, and external partners (auditors, consultants)
Build and evolve systems, tooling, and workflows to improve accuracy, efficiency, and visibility
Oversee the stock option/equity program and management of the cap table.

Leverage Agentic AI

Use Agentic AI to automate key processes such as: accounts receivable, month-end close, and financial package preparation

Team leadership & development

Lead and mentor the finance and accounting team, setting a high bar for accountability and performance
Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration

What You’ll Bring

Experience in a venture-backed or scaling SaaS company
CPA designation (or equivalent) with 10+ years of progressive experience across accounting and finance
Early-career foundation in accounting (e.g., audit, controllership) with a transition into broader finance leadership
Experience owning both accounting operations and FP&A in a high-growth SaaS or tech environment
Strong understanding of SaaS metrics, revenue recognition, and financial best practices
Proficiency using AI tools to streamline and enhance financial modelling, reporting and workflows
Comfort operating as a hands-on leader, including stepping into payroll, reporting, or operational tasks when needed
Proven ability to build, improve, and scale financial processes and systems
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial data into clear insights
Experience with modern finance tools (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Stripe, Carta, QuickBooks Online)

Nice to have

Exposure to international finance operations and multi-entity structures
Experience managing or implementing financial systems and automation initiatives
Familiarity with BI or dashboarding tools (e.g., Metabase, Looker, Tableau)
Experience supporting board reporting and investor relations

Location

There is a strong preference for candidates based in Ontario for easier collaboration and occasional in-person meetings in our HQ office (Ottawa).

Compensation Philosophy

The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework.

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.

Why join Rewind

At Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses. We’re performance-driven, innovative, and not afraid to challenge what’s possible. You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow.

We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries.

How Rewind Will Support You

We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. We also offer a variety of benefits to support your success both at work and in your personal life which includes but is not limited to:

Flexible work hours
Employee stock options
Health benefits
3 weeks vacation
7 life leave days
2 Level Up days for professional development
1 volunteer day
Summer Fridays and office closed during the holiday break in December
Paid parental leave
$2000/year wellness/home office allowance
$5000/year professional development allowance

Rewind is committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.

AI Usage

Our recruitment process may include the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools to help manage and review applications efficiently. These tools assist our team, but hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

jobs.title: Field Chief Technology Officer - North America East
jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Technical authority and commercial judgement create the bridge between architecture and business outcomes. As a 1Password Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO), you’ll help the world’s largest organizations navigate that bridge while shaping the future of enterprise identity security.

The Field CTO is the most senior customer-facing technical advisor within the 1Password Solutions Engineering organization. You’ll influence enterprise technology leaders, accelerate adoption of the 1Password platform and help define how modern organizations secure every sign-in to every application from every device, including AI agents.

You’ll partner with executive buyers, enterprise architects, developers and security practitioners to solve some of the industry’s most complex identity and access challenges. You’ll engage in our most strategic customer opportunities, represent 1Password in executive briefings, customer advisory boards, industry events and executive forums, and serve as a trusted advisor to Product, Engineering and GTM leadership. You’ll focus your efforts where executive technical leadership can materially influence customer outcomes, while transforming those experiences into repeatable technical motions that scale across the broader Solutions Engineering organization.

Beyond customer engagement, you’ll help scale the technical capabilities of the entire Solutions Engineering organization. You’ll transform customer insights into repeatable playbooks, mentor senior Solutions Engineers, influence product direction and establish technical strategies that improve how we engage enterprise customers around the world.

How We’re Using AI Today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity, consulting, solutions engineering, enterprise architecture or technical leadership roles.
Demonstrated success influencing executive technology leaders within Fortune 500 organizations.
Deep technical expertise across identity, access management, privileged access, cloud security, developer platforms, SaaS security or AI security.
Exceptional executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to simplify highly complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for executive audiences.
Proven ability to influence enterprise architecture decisions across large, complex organizations.
Experience supporting strategic enterprise sales opportunities and partnering closely with executive sales teams.
Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes and modern sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.
Experience building technical strategies, reusable methodologies or customer engagement frameworks that scale beyond individual contributions.
Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy through customer engagement and market insights.
Proven ability to build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Sales and executive leadership while influencing without direct authority.
Experience speaking to diverse audiences at industry conferences, executive forums and analyst events.
Willingness to travel up to 50%.

Success in This Role

Within Your First 12 To 18 Months, You Will

Influence the successful outcome of 1Password’s most strategic customer opportunities and executive relationships.
Build trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering and GTM leadership that shape future platform investments.
Create repeatable technical plays, executive messaging and reference architectures adopted across the global Solutions Engineering organization.
Elevate the technical capabilities of the field through mentorship, thought leadership and executive engagement.
Expand 1Password’s influence across the identity security community through conference speaking, customer advisory boards and industry events.

What You Can Expect

Serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers

Build relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, Chief Architects and technical decision makers across Fortune 500 organizations.
Participate in executive briefings, architecture reviews and strategic workshops to help customers solve complex identity, access and security challenges.
Participate in executive customer meetings where senior technical leadership is needed to build consensus, align C-level priorities with technical teams and accelerate strategic initiatives.
Provide technical leadership throughout the sales cycle, helping account teams navigate architecture discussions, competitive evaluations and executive decision making.
Support our most strategic opportunities by accelerating technical alignment, reducing execution risk and building customer confidence.

Shape the Future of Solutions Engineering

Build repeatable technical motions, executive messaging, reference architectures and technical playbooks that scale across the global Solutions Engineering organization.
Mentor senior Solutions Engineers and help raise the technical and consultative capabilities of the broader team.
Partner with Sales Leadership, Solutions Engineering Leadership and Enablement to identify emerging technical trends, strategic opportunities and areas for organizational investment.
Develop enablement programs that prepare the field for emerging technologies and evolving customer challenges.
Serve as a technical thought leader across the organization, helping define best practices for enterprise engagement.

Influence Product Strategy

Serve as the executive voice of the field by bringing customer feedback, competitive intelligence and implementation insights directly to Product and Engineering leadership.
Partner with Product Management and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities, validate emerging capabilities and support early customer adoption programs.
Help translate emerging market trends into actionable product and GTM strategies.

Represent 1Password Externally

Speak at conferences, executive events, customer advisory boards, analyst briefings and industry forums.
Develop technical thought leadership through presentations, blogs, webinars, whitepapers and executive content.
Build credibility with customers, industry analysts, strategic partners and the broader security community while strengthening 1Password’s market position.
Be called upon to join high-impact, in-person customer engagements where executive technical leadership can build alignment, accelerate decision-making and strengthen strategic relationships.
Serve as the executive technical face of 1Password for our most strategic customers and partners.
Shape how 1Password engages enterprise organizations around identity security, AI, developer security and modern access management.
Partner directly with executive leadership across Product, Engineering, Marketing and Go-to-Market to influence company strategy.
Help define the future of Solutions Engineering by mentoring technical leaders and building scalable customer engagement models.
Represent 1Password on some of the industry’s biggest stages while helping organizations securely navigate the future of identity.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $228,000 USD and $342,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $228,000 CAD and $342,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.
